aca_msg_book1_1_04_backward_arcade

Begin moving by using the accelerator: $input forward$.

Reverse past the dashed line.
trans-unit.target:
가속 페달을 사용하여 이동을 시작합니다: $input forward$.

점선을 지나 후진하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_04_backward_automatic
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_04_backward_automatic Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_04

Reverse past the dashed line.

가속 페달을 사용하여 이동을 시작합니다: $input forward$.

점선을 지나 후진하십시오.

Release the clutch slowly, while maintaining the engine's RPM by using the accelerator.

Reverse past the dashed line.
trans-unit.target:
가속 페달을 밟아 엔진의 RPM을 유지하면서 클러치를 천천히 놓습니다.

점선을 지나 후진하십시오.

aca_msg_book1_1_04_park_br_on
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_04_park_br_on Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_04

trans-unit.source:
With a simplified automatic transmission, there's no need to shift gears as everything is done automatically for you, unlike in reality.

Press @@imv_nrm_activate@@ to confirm.
trans-unit.target:
간소화된 자동변속기를 사용하면 현실과 달리 모든 것이 자동으로 이루어지므로 기어를 바꿀 필요가 없습니다.

확인하려면 @@imv_nrm_activate@@를 누르십시오.

aca_msg_book1_1_04_gear_n_arcade
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_04_gear_n_arcade Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_04

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Shift into neutral by pressing @@imv_nrm_gearup@@.</font>@@aca_goal_tip@@ Modern trucks will automatically shift to neutral when the parking brake is applied. However, it is a good habit to always do it yourself. In the following scenarios, we will not require this step.
trans-unit.target: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>@@imv_nrm_gearup@@을 눌러 중립으로 전환합니다.</font>@@aca_goal_tip@@ 최신 트럭은 주차 브레이크를 밟으면 자동으로 중립으로 전환합니다. 그러나 항상 직접 하는 것이 좋은 습관입니다. 다음 시나리오에서는 이 단계가 필요하지 않습니다.

aca_msg_book1_1_04_gear_n_automatic

However, it is a good habit to always do it yourself. In the following scenarios, we will not require this step.
trans-unit.target: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>기어 스틱을 중립으로 바꾼 다음 클러치를 놓습니다.</font>@@aca_goal_tip@@ 최신 트럭은 주차 브레이크를 밟으면 자동으로 중립으로 변속합니다. 그러나 항상 직접 하는 것이 좋은 습관입니다. 다음 시나리오에서는 이 단계가 필요하지 않습니다.

trans-unit.source:
Remember to always be aware of your surroundings as you reverse, especially in busy areas with lots of traffic.

Shut down the engine by pressing $input engineelect$.
trans-unit.target:
후진할 때는 항상 주변 환경을 주의하세요. 특히 교통량이 많은 복잡한 지역에서는 더욱 그렇습니다.

$input engineelect$을(를) 눌러 엔진을 끄십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_04_end
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_04_end Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_04

aca_scenario_book1_1_05_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_1_05_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
In this scenario, we'll explore some of the truck's basic controls that help to maintain a clear view of your surroundings and make your driving predictable for other road users.

You'll learn to use windscreen wipers to maintain good visibility in bad weather as well as the controls for lights and turn signals.
trans-unit.target:
이 시나리오에서는 주변을 깨끗하게 유지하고 다른 도로 이용자에게 예측 가능한 운전을 하는 데 도움이 되는 트럭의 기본 제어 장치에 대해 알아보겠습니다.

악천후에 좋은 가시성을 유지하기 위한 와이퍼의 사용법과 조명 및 방향지시등의 제어 방법을 배우게 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_1_05_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_1_05_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

Id: aca_goal_book1_1_05_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

aca_goal_book1_1_05_end
Id: aca_goal_book1_1_05_end Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll go over some of the truck's features that will ensure that you can see and be seen at the same time.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 트럭의 몇 가지 기능을 살펴보겠습니다. 이 기능을 사용하면 운전자가 동시에 차량을 보고, 다른 사람에게 보이게 할 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_cutscene1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source: We'll activate the various lighting systems and learn when it is necessary to use each of them.
trans-unit.target: 다양한 조명 시스템을 활성화하고 각각을 언제 사용해야 하는지 알아보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_cutscene2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source: We'll operate the left and right turn signals.
trans-unit.target: 좌 우 회전 신호를 작동해 보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_cutscene3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source: And finally, we'll go over how to adjust the wipers to ensure they function effectively in varying levels of precipitation.
trans-unit.target: 마지막으로, 다양한 강수량에 맞게 와이퍼가 효과적으로 작동하도록 조정하는 방법을 살펴보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_cutscene4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
Let's go over how to use various types of lights, as well as how to control the windscreen wipers.

Low beam and high beam headlights ensure a good view of the road ahead. Turn signals and hazard lights are used so that other road users can anticipate your manoeuvres.

Wipers are used to keep the windscreen clear of water and other debris.

Start the engine, but do not release the parking brake.
trans-unit.target:
다양한 유형의 조명을 사용하는 방법과 와이퍼를 제어하는 ​​방법을 살펴보겠습니다.

하향등과 상향등은 앞길을 잘 볼 수 있도록 합니다. 방향지시등과 비상등은 다른 도로 사용자가 귀하의 조작을 예상할 수 있도록 사용됩니다.

와이퍼는 앞유리를 물과 기타 이물질로부터 깨끗하게 유지하는 데 사용됩니다.

엔진을 시동하지만 주차 브레이크는 풀지 마십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.note:
Há um "espaço" antes de "Ligue o motor..." Segue abaixo a correção

Ligue o motor, mas não solte o freio de estacionamento.

The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "Vamos revisar como usar os vários tipos de luzes, assim como controlar os limpadores de para-brisa.

Os faróis baixo e alto garantem uma boa visibilidade da estrada à frente. Os sinais de conversão e os pisca-alerta são usados para que outros usuários da via possam antecipar suas manobras.

Os limpadores são utilizados para manter o para-brisa livre de água e outros detritos.

Ligue o motor, mas não solte o freio de estacionamento. "

trans-unit.source:
So far, you have only been using daytime running lights. They automatically activate when the ignition is turned on and are used for better visibility of the vehicle under normal conditions. However, now that conditions have worsened, you will need to use the full lighting system.

Press @@imv_nrm_light@@ to turn on the parking lights.
trans-unit.target:
지금까지 주간 주행등만 사용해 왔습니다. 이 조명은 점화가 켜지면 자동으로 작동하며 일반적인 조건에서 차량의 가시성을 높이는 데 사용됩니다. 그러나 이제 조건이 악화되었으므로 전체 조명 시스템을 사용해야 합니다.

주차등을 켜려면 @@imv_nrm_light@@을(를) 누르십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_parking
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_parking Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_low_beam_img@@
Parking lights illuminate the front, side and rear marker lights. They're used when you are parked in poor lighting conditions so that you are visible to other drivers.

Press @@imv_nrm_light@@ to switch to low beam headlights.
trans-unit.target:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_low_beam_img@@
차폭등은 전면, 측면 및 후면 마커등을 비춥니다. 조명이 어두운 곳에 주차했을 때 다른 운전자에게 보이도록 하기 위해 사용됩니다.

@@imv_nrm_light@@를 눌러 하향 전조등으로 전환합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_low_beam
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_low_beam Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_high_beam_on_img@@
Low beam headlights illuminate the road ahead of you and also improve the visibility of your vehicle in poor lighting conditions.

Use @@imv_nrm_hblight@@ to switch to high beam headlights.
trans-unit.target:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_high_beam_on_img@@
하향 전조등은 앞의 도로를 비추고 조명이 어두운 상황에서 차량의 가시성을 높여줍니다.

@@imv_nrm_hblight@@를 사용하여 상향 전조등으로 전환하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_high_beam_on
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_high_beam_on Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_high_beam_off_img@@
High beam headlights allow you to see further down the road in poor lighting conditions.

Be mindful when using them, though, as they can dazzle other road users, especially those in oncoming traffic. Be sure to turn your high beams off as you approach other drivers.

Use @@imv_nrm_hblight@@ to turn the high beam headlights off.
trans-unit.target:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_high_beam_off_img@@
상향 전조등은 조명이 어두울 때 도로를 더 멀리 볼 수 있게 해줍니다.

하지만 다른 도로 이용자, 특히 반대편에서 오는 차량의 눈부심을 유발할 수 있으므로 사용할 때는 주의하세요. 다른 운전자에게 다가갈 때는 반드시 상향등을 끄십시오.

@@imv_nrm_hblight@@를 사용하여 상향 전조등을 끕니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_high_beam_off
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_high_beam_off Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
Now, let's look at the turn signals. The function of turn signals is to provide a visual signal to other road users about a lane change or a change in direction.

Press @@imv_nrm_lblinker@@ to activate the left turn signal.
trans-unit.target:
이제 방향지시등을 살펴보겠습니다. 방향지시등의 기능은 차선 변경이나 방향 전환에 대한 시각적 신호를 다른 도로 이용자에게 제공하는 것입니다.

@@imv_nrm_lblinker@@를 눌러 좌회전 신호를 활성화하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_lblinker_on
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_lblinker_on Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_lblinker_off_img@@
You'll notice that the left signal light indicator is flashing on the dashboard. The left turn signals are also flashing on the left side of the truck.

Now press @@imv_nrm_lblinker@@ to turn off the left turn signal.
trans-unit.target:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_lblinker_off_img@@
대시보드에서 왼쪽 신호 표시등이 깜빡거리는 것을 알 수 있습니다. 좌회전 신호도 트럭 왼쪽에서 깜빡입니다.

이제 @@imv_nrm_lblinker@@를 눌러 좌회전 신호를 끄십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_lblinker_off
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_lblinker_off Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
Signals indicating a change in direction should be given in a timely manner, so that other road users have time to anticipate your manoeuvre and adjust their driving accordingly.

Press @@imv_nrm_rblinker@@ to activate the right turn signal.
trans-unit.target:
방향 전환을 나타내는 신호는 적절한 시기에 제공되어야 하며, 다른 도로 이용자들이 귀하의 조작을 예상하고 이에 따라 운전을 조정할 시간을 가질 수 있도록 해야 합니다.

@@imv_nrm_rblinker@@를 눌러 우회전 신호를 활성화하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_rblinker_on
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_rblinker_on Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_rblinker_off_img@@
On the dashboard, the right signal light indicator is now flashing. At the same time, the turn signals are flashing on the right side of the truck.

Now press @@imv_nrm_rblinker@@ to turn off the right turn signal.
trans-unit.target:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_rblinker_off_img@@
대시보드에서 오른쪽 신호 표시등이 깜빡입니다. 동시에, 트럭 오른쪽 방향지시등이 깜빡입니다.

이제 @@imv_nrm_rblinker@@를 눌러 오른쪽 방향지시등을 끄십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_rblinker_off
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_rblinker_off Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_hazard_on_img@@
The hazard light switch is indicated by a red, triangle-shaped logo. These lights are an important part of road safety and should only be used when necessary. This function activates both the left and right turn signals simultaneously.

Press @@imv_nrm_flasher4way@@ to turn on the hazard lights.
trans-unit.target:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_hazard_on_img@@
비상등 스위치는 빨간색 삼각형 로고로 표시됩니다, 이 표시등은 도로 안전의 중요한 부분이며 필요한 경우에만 사용해야 합니다. 이 기능은 좌회전 및 우회전 신호를 동시에 활성화합니다.

@@imv_nrm_flasher4way@@를 눌러 위험등을 켭니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_hazard_on
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_hazard_on Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_hazard_off_img@@
Both turn signal indicators are now flashing, indicating that the hazard lights are on. At the same time, the turn signals are flashing on both sides of the truck.

Hazard lights are typically used when the truck is stopped in a place where it normally wouldn't be, such as the side of the road because of a technical or mechanical issue. They can also be used to warn drivers behind you of stopped traffic ahead.

Now, press @@imv_nrm_flasher4way@@ to turn off the hazard lights.
trans-unit.target:
@@aca_msg_book1_1_05_hazard_off_img@@
두 방향지시등이 깜박이며 비상등이 켜져 있음을 나타냅니다. 동시에, 방향지시등이 트럭 양쪽에서 깜박입니다.

비상등은 일반적으로 트럭이 기술적 또는 기계적 문제로 인해 도로변과 같이 정상적으로 정지하지 않는 곳에 정지했을 때 사용됩니다. 또한 뒤따르는 운전자에게 앞에 정지한 차량을 경고하는 데 사용할 수도 있습니다.

이제 @@imv_nrm_flasher4way@@을 눌러 비상등을 끕니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_hazard_off
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_hazard_off Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
Now, let's move on to the windscreen wipers. Windscreen wipers are used to remove rain and other debris from the vehicle's windscreen. Their main function is to keep the windscreen clean and clear. Wipers have several speed settings.

Press @@imv_nrm_wipers@@ to set the windscreen wipers to the intermittent setting. @@aca_goal_tip@@ In the Career, you can use the rain sensor to automatically engage the windscreen wipers when it's raining. You can find the @@rain_sensor@@ settings in the Options Screen - 'Gameplay'.
trans-unit.target:
이제 앞유리 와이퍼로 넘어가겠습니다. 앞유리 와이퍼는 차량의 앞유리에서 비와 기타 이물질을 제거하는 데 사용됩니다. 주요 기능은 앞유리를 깨끗하고 깨끗하게 유지하는 것입니다. 와이퍼에는 여러 가지 속도 설정이 있습니다.

앞유리 와이퍼를 간헐적으로 설정하려면 @@imv_nrm_wipers@@를 누르십시오.@@aca_goal_tip@@ 커리어에서 레인 센서를 사용하여 비가 올 때 앞유리 와이퍼를 자동으로 작동시킬 수 있습니다. 옵션 화면 - '게임 플레이' @@rain_sensor@@에서 설정을 찾을 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers_on
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers_on Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.note: Na linha "Sua função principal é manter o para-brisa limpo e claro", o ideal seria "Sua função principal é manter o para-brisa limpo e desobstruído"
@DTavares2112 Changed to "Sua função principal é manter o para-brisa limpo." as it is implied it is free of any obstructions.

trans-unit.source:
This setting allows for the wipers to periodically activate. This is useful when precipitation is very light.

As you can see, the rain is too heavy, and the wipers are unable to keep up with the amount of rain falling on the windscreen.

Press @@imv_nrm_wipers@@ again to switch the windscreen wipers to the low-speed setting.
trans-unit.target:
이 설정은 와이퍼가 주기적으로 작동하도록 합니다. 강수량이 매우 적을 때 유용합니다.

보시다시피, 비가 너무 많이 내리고 와이퍼가 앞유리에 떨어지는 비의 양을 따라잡을 수 없습니다.

@@imv_nrm_wipers@@를 다시 눌러 앞유리 와이퍼를 저속 설정으로 전환합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers2
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.note:
"to the low-speed setting" - This is a mistake because it does not reduce, but increases the speed of the wipers and further in the text of the lesson this is confirmed.
"to the high-speed setting" - it will be right.

@_ResTed_ I disagree (even though I should have seen it much earlier). My interpretation is that we are going from interval wipers to continous wipers, although at a low speed. If so, this string is correct. It should be: Off - Interval - Low - High. And in this context, you change from interval to low speed.
@Nettle could you please clarify this query?

It is as @TobiasHenricsson says. It could be further clarified as "...to switch the windscreen wipers to the continuous low-speed setting." or a similar phrase, but for now I would leave it as is in EN. If you feel it needs to be clearer in your language, feel free to add or suggest it.

@Nettle I want to draw attention to whole text, the second line says that the rain is very heavy, so it is logical to assume that there is a need to increase speed of wipers, but then they say that their speed needs to be reduced, which is not logical. Thus, if you are going to take this lesson in game, then the rain is really heavy, so you need to increase speed, not decrease it, as I said in first message. That is, need to change the original text, because it does not correspond to what is happening in game.

@_ResTed_ That is just how labels on car wipers work. Before this message, the wipers are off. It starts raining. Player turns them on (they are now set on intermittent wipe/periodic activation, meaning wipers activate every few seconds). The rain is too heavy for this setting, and the player is prompted to increase it. When he does, the wipers go up to the low-speed setting, meaning the wipers activate continuously but at a slow rate. If the rain gets heavier or if the player finds this setting is not fast enough, he can increase it further to the high-speed setting, but that is not what happens during this step of the tutorial. Feel free to check the following link with the explanation on wiper settings from a car manufacturer. https://www.chevrolet.com/support/vehicle/climate-seat-controls/windshield-wiper-controls

trans-unit.source:
Now the wipers are working at a consistent speed to clear the rain.

Press @@imv_nrm_wipers@@ once more to set the high-speed setting.
trans-unit.target:
이제 와이퍼가 일정한 속도로 작동하여 비를 씻어냅니다.

@@imv_nrm_wipers@@를 다시 한 번 눌러 고속 설정을 지정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers3
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
You can see the wipers are working much faster now to clear the windscreen for maximum visibility.

Press @@imv_nrm_wipers@@ to turn the wipers off. @@aca_goal_tip@@ You can also use the @@o_im_wipers_back@@ function to cycle backwards through the wipers speed settings. Check the Options Screen - '@@options_bindings_screen@@' - to see and/or change corresponding controls.
trans-unit.target:
와이퍼가 훨씬 더 빨리 작동하여 최대한의 가시성을 위해 앞유리를 비우는 것을 볼 수 있습니다.

@@imv_nrm_wipers@@를 눌러 와이퍼를 끕니다.@@aca_goal_tip@@ @@o_im_wipers_back@@ 기능을 사용하여 와이퍼 속도 설정을 뒤로 순환할 수도 있습니다. 옵션 화면 - '@@options_bindings_screen@@'을 확인하여 해당 컨트롤을 확인 또는 변경합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers_off
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers_off Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source:
You can see the wipers are working much faster now to clear the windscreen for maximum visibility.

Press @@imv_nrm_wipersback@@ multiple times until wipers are turned off.
trans-unit.target:
와이퍼가 훨씬 더 빨리 작동하여 앞 유리창을 깨끗이 닦아 시야를 최대한 확보한 것을 볼 수 있습니다.

와이퍼가 꺼질 때까지 @@imv_nrm_wipersback@@을 여러 번 누르십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers_off_back
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_wipers_off_back Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Turn off the lights and shut down the engine. </font>

aca_msg_book1_1_05_end
Id: aca_msg_book1_1_05_end Group: Book 1 Scenario 1_05

@DTavares2112 Hi, I noticed that in instances where the source text says something related to securing the truck, the translation was along the lines of "putting the truck in safety". Instead, it simply means that the parking brake must be applied and the engine turned off.
@QL_BR_T Hello, I agree, it makes for a smoother translation.

trans-unit.source:
To complete this scenario, you must drive around all the cones without hitting any of them.

Press @@imv_nrm_activate@@ to confirm.

이 시나리오를 완료하려면 어느 것에도 부딪히지 않고 모든 콘 주위를 운전해야 합니다.

For the passenger's side, the front and side mirrors can be very helpful in orienting yourself.

Press @@imv_nrm_activate@@ to confirm.

거울을 사용하여 트럭의 양쪽을 모두 볼 수 있도록 하세요.

조수석 쪽의 경우, 앞 거울과 옆 거울은 방향을 잡는 데 매우 유용합니다.

확인하려면 @@imv_nrm_activate@@를 누르십시오.

aca_msg_book1_2_01_mirror

Adjust your mirrors, if necessary, in '@@adjust_link_t@@' (Access it via the pause menu).

Prepare to set off.

필요하다면 '@@adjust_link_t@@'에서 거울을 조정합니다(일시 정지 메뉴를 통해 접근).

출발을 준비하십시오.

트럭이 아직 움직일 준비가 안 됐는데, 뭔가 잊은 게 있나요?

엔진은 켜져 있나요? 주차 브레이크는 풀었나요?

뒷바퀴가 코너 안쪽에 있는 트래픽콘을 통과할 수 있도록 코너 깊은 곳까지 운전해야 합니다.

The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "Teremos que dirigir bem para dentro da curva para que as rodas traseiras passem sem encostar no cone de trânsito no lado interno da curva.
Use os retrovisores!"

trans-unit.source: Straighten out, drive towards the final barriers, then stop and secure the truck.
trans-unit.target: 앞바퀴를 정렬 하고, 마지막 장벽을 향해 운전한 후 멈춰서 트럭을 고정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_02_cutscene5
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_02_cutscene5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_02

aca_msg_book1_2_02_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_02_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_02

trans-unit.source:
The truck still isn't ready to move, maybe you've forgotten something?

Is the engine on? Have you released the parking brake?
trans-unit.target:
트럭이 아직 움직일 준비가 안 됐는데, 뭔가 잊은 게 있나요?

엔진은 켜져 있나요? 주차 브레이크는 풀었나요?

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_02_start_fail
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_02_start_fail Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_02

trans-unit.source:
Straight ahead of you is a marked spot just before the barrier.

Drive forwards and stop in the marked spot.
trans-unit.target:
장벽 바로 앞에 표시된 지점이 있습니다.

앞으로 운전하여 표시된 지점에서 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_02_check1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_02_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_02

trans-unit.source:
Look behind you on the driver's side; You'll see another marked spot there. You'll have to combine reversing with turning at the same time.

Reverse around the curve and stop in the marked spot.
trans-unit.target:
운전석 쪽 뒤를 돌아보세요. 거기에 또 다른 표시된 지점이 보일 겁니다. 후진과 회전을 동시에 병행해야 합니다.

커브를 돌면서 후진하고 표시된 지점에서 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_02_check2
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_02_check2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_02

trans-unit.source:
The course continues ahead of you through a 90 degree turn.

Stay to the driver's side before the turn, drive deep into the corner and turn quickly and sharply. Be sure not to hit the inside traffic cone.

Drive forwards and make the turn.
trans-unit.target:
코스는 90도 회전을 통해 앞으로 계속됩니다.

회전하기 전에 운전석 쪽으로 유지하고, 코너 깊게 운전하고 빠르고 날카롭게 회전합니다. 안쪽 트래픽콘에 부딪히지 않도록 주의해야 됩니다.

앞으로 운전하고 회전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_02_check3
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_02_check3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_02

trans-unit.source:
Use your front and side mirrors to ensure you don't hit anything.

Complete the turn and stop in the designated area.
trans-unit.target:
전방 미러와 사이드 미러를 이용해 아무것도 부딪히지 않도록 주의합니다.

회전을 마치고 지정된 구역에서 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_02_check4
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_02_check4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_02

trans-unit.note:
The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "Use os retrovisores frontal e lateral para garantir que você não bata em nada.

Complete a curva e pare na área indicada."

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Shut down the engine and secure the truck.</font>

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_02_end
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_02_end Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_02

aca_scenario_book1_2_03_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_03_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll talk about the front mirror - its location and how to utilize it effectively to stop close to an obstacle in front.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 전방 미러에 대해 이야기해보겠습니다. 전방 미러의 위치와 장애물 가까이에서 멈추기 위해 효과적으로 사용하는 방법에 대해 알아보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_2_03_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_03_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

aca_goal_book1_2_03_mirror
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_03_mirror Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

aca_goal_book1_2_03_mirror_msg
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_03_mirror_msg Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.note: should say "its"

context-group.context:
aca_goal_book1_2_03_check1
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_03_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source: Trucks have a large blind spot in the area in front of the tractor. It's easy to lose sight of a pedestrian or even a car in this area, so trucks are equipped with a front mirror that can be seen through the windscreen.
trans-unit.target: 트럭은 트랙터 앞 부분에 큰 사각지대가 있습니다. 이 부분에서는 보행자나 자동차를 놓치기 쉽기 때문에 트럭에는 앞 유리창을 통해 볼 수 있는 전방 미러가 장착되어 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_cutscene1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source:
The front mirror is designed to give the driver a view into this blind spot.
It is an essential tool to ensure you don't collide with any obstacles when manoeuvring in tight spaces.
trans-unit.target:
전방 미러는 운전자에게 이러한 사각 지대를 보여주기 위해 설계되었습니다.
좁은 공간에서 차량을 조작할 때 장애물과 충돌하지 않도록 하는 데 필수적인 도구입니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_cutscene2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source:
Start driving, proceed towards the barrier ahead of you, then slow down as you approach it.
Keep an eye on the front mirror.
trans-unit.target:
운전을 시작하고, 앞에 있는 장벽을 향해 나아간 다음 접근하면서 속도를 줄입니다.
전방 미러를 주시 하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_cutscene3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source: Stop between the line and the obstacle.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_cutscene4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.note: all of the Academy strings are putting our imperative mood

trans-unit.source:
In this scenario, we'll learn to use the front mirror shown in the diagram.

Look through the top portion of the windscreen to see it.@@aca_goal_tip@@ You have to be inside the vehicle.
trans-unit.target:
이 시나리오에서는 다이어그램에 표시된 전면 거울을 사용하는 방법을 알아보겠습니다.

앞유리 상단 부분을 통해 살펴봅니다.@@aca_goal_tip@@ 차량 내부에 있어야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_mirror
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_mirror Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source:
The front mirror allows you to see into the blind spot in front of the truck. It can help you to be safe and precise in your driving.

If you're not satisfied with the adjustment, open '@@adjust_link_t@@' (can be accessed via the pause menu) to adjust it to your liking.

Press @@imv_nrm_activate@@ to continue.
trans-unit.target:
전방 미러는 트럭 앞의 사각지대를 볼 수 있게 해줍니다. 운전을 안전하고 정확하게 하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

조정에 만족하지 않으면 '@@adjust_link_t@@'(일시 중지 메뉴를 통해 액세스 가능)을 열어 원하는 대로 조정합니다.

계속하려면 @@imv_nrm_activate@@을(를) 누르십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_mirror_msg
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_mirror_msg Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source:
Straight ahead of the truck there is a marked spot. You'll notice that there's an obstacle on the other side of the spot; when you're near it, drive very slowly and check the distance to the obstacle in the front mirror.

Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
트럭 바로 앞에는 표시된 지점이 있습니다. 그 지점의 너머에 장애물이 있는 것을 알 수 있을 것입니다. 장애물에 가까워지면 매우 천천히 운전하고 전방 미러로 장애물까지의 거리를 확인합니다.

출발을 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source:
The truck still isn't ready to move, maybe you've forgotten something?

Is the engine on? Have you released the parking brake?
trans-unit.target:
트럭이 아직 움직일 준비가 안 됐는데, 뭔가 잊은 게 있나요?

엔진은 켜져 있나요? 주차 브레이크는 풀었나요?

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_start_fail
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_start_fail Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

aca_msg_book1_2_03_check1_msg
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_check1_msg Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

trans-unit.source:
@@aca_msg_book1_2_03_check1_img@@
Stop the front of the truck between the obstacle and the painted road marking.
trans-unit.target:
@@aca_msg_book1_2_03_check1_img@@
트럭의 앞부분을 장애물과 페인트칠된 도로 표시 사이에 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_03_check1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_03_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_03

aca_scenario_book1_2_04_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_04_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll learn to park next to a kerb using the side-view mirror.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 사이드 미러를 사용하여 연석 옆에 주차하는 방법을 알아보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_2_04_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_04_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

aca_goal_book1_2_04_mirror
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_04_mirror Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

aca_goal_book1_2_04_check1
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_04_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source: The side-view mirror is another tool that will help you to safely manoeuvre the truck. It's located on the upper frame of the passenger's door.
trans-unit.target: 사이드 미러는 트럭을 안전하게 조종하는 데 도움이 되는 또 다른 도구입니다. 조수석 도어의 상단 프레임에 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source: Drive forwards and slowly turn to you passenger side.
trans-unit.target: 앞으로 운전하고 천천히 조수석쪽으로 방향을 바꾸십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene1b
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene1b Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.note: Missing "r" at the end of "...you passenger side" here?

trans-unit.source:
These wooden planks represent a kerb. You'll need to park next to it.
Turn towards the kerb to get the truck into a good position to line up with the parking spot.
trans-unit.target:
이 나무 판자는 연석을 나타냅니다. 그 옆에 주차해야 합니다.
연석 쪽으로 돌아서 트럭을 주차 지점과 일렬로 정렬할 수 있는 좋은 위치에 두십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source: Slow down well before the kerb and turn towards the parking spot. As you straighten out, you can use the side-view mirror to judge your distance from the kerb.
trans-unit.target: 연석에 도착하기 훨씬 전에 속도를 줄이고 주차 지점 쪽으로 방향을 틀어보십시오. 똑바로 세우면서 사이드 미러를 사용하여 연석과의 거리를 판단할 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source: Stop in the parking spot and secure the truck.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_cutscene4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Look through the window on the passenger's side. You can see the side-view mirror there.</font>@@aca_goal_tip@@ You have to be inside the vehicle.
trans-unit.target: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>조수석 쪽 창문을 들여다보십시오. 거기에 사이드 미러가 보입니다.</font>@@aca_goal_tip@@ 차량 안에 있어야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_mirror
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_mirror Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source:
The side-view mirror covers the area on the passenger's side where the driver can't see. It's one of the most problematic blind spots on the truck. If the angle of the mirror doesn't suit you, you can adjust it in '@@adjust_link_t@@'.

Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
사이드 미러는 운전자가 볼 수 없는 조수석 쪽 영역을 커버합니다. 트럭에서 가장 문제가 되는 사각지대 중 ​​하나입니다. 미러 각도가 마음에 들지 않으면 '@@adjust_link_t@@'에서 조정할 수 있습니다.

출발을 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source:
The truck still isn't ready to move, maybe you've forgotten something?

Is the engine on? Have you released the parking brake?
trans-unit.target:
트럭이 아직 움직일 준비가 안 됐는데, 뭔가 잊은 게 있나요?

엔진은 켜져 있나요? 주차 브레이크는 풀었나요?

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_start_fail
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_start_fail Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source:
Ahead of you there is a line of planks representing a kerb. At the end of the kerb is a parking spot. You'll need to drive there.

Proceed when you're ready.
trans-unit.target:
당신 앞에는 연석을 나타내는 판자 줄이 있습니다. 연석 끝에는 주차 공간이 있습니다. 거기까지 운전해야 합니다.

준비가 되면 계속하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_forward
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_forward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source:
Turn towards the kerb. Use the front and side mirrors to check your position in relation to the kerb, but also be sure to not run over any traffic cones.

Drive towards the kerb and into the parking spot.
trans-unit.target:
연석 쪽으로 방향을 바꾸세요. 전방 미러와 사이드 미러를 사용하여 연석과 관련된 위치를 확인하세요, 그러나 교통 콘을 밟지 않도록 주의하세요.

연석 쪽으로 운전하여 주차 공간으로 들어가십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_check1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Secure the truck and shut down the engine.</font>@@aca_goal_tip@@ You can use Interior Look presets to make looking at mirrors easier. Check the Options Screen - '@@options_bindings_screen@@' - to see and/or change corresponding controls.
trans-unit.target: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>트럭을 고정하고 엔진을 끄십시오.</font>@@aca_goal_tip@@ 인테리어 룩 프리셋을 사용하여 거울을 더 쉽게 볼 수 있습니다. 옵션 화면 - '@@options_bindings_screen@@' - 에서 해당 컨트롤을 확인하거나 변경할 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_04_end
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_04_end Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_04

trans-unit.source: Reverse Parking Next to an Obstacle

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_2_05_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_05_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

trans-unit.note: For some reason, in Brazilian Portuguese, the information that appears is the string ID "aca_scenario_book1_2_05_title". Below is a screenshot. https://prnt.sc/CBl5TYj-EWTN
@Nettle could you please check if this is still present in game?
Seems to be fine in both ATS and ETS2.

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll reverse the truck into a parking spot next to a kerb.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 트럭을 후진하여 연석 옆 주차 공간으로 이동합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_2_05_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_05_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

aca_goal_book1_2_05_summary
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_05_summary Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

aca_goal_book1_2_05_backward
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_05_backward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

aca_goal_book1_2_05_stop
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_05_stop Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll perform a reverse manoeuvre to park next to a kerb.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 연석 옆에 주차하기 위해 후진 조작을 수행합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_05_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_05_cutscene1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

trans-unit.source:
Reverse towards the kerb.
You must be aware of your surroundings when reversing, so use your mirrors.
trans-unit.target:
연석 쪽으로 후진합니다.
후진할 때는 주변 상황을 주의해서 살펴야 하므로 거울을 사용하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_05_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_05_cutscene2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

trans-unit.source: As you get closer you can start to align the truck with the parking spot. Watch both sides of the truck as you reverse.
trans-unit.target: 가까이 다가가면 트럭을 주차 지점에 정렬할 수 있습니다. 후진할 때 트럭의 양쪽 측면을 주의 깊게 살펴보십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_05_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_05_cutscene3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

trans-unit.source: Stop in the parking spot and secure the truck.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_05_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_05_cutscene4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

trans-unit.source:
The parking spot is behind you towards the passenger's side. Use your mirrors to navigate your way towards the spot.

Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
주차 공간은 조수석 쪽 뒤에 있습니다. 거울을 사용하여 주차 공간으로 갑니다.

출발 준비를 하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_05_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_05_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

trans-unit.source:
Remember to use your mirrors to check your surroundings before moving the truck.

Begin reversing towards the kerb.
trans-unit.target:
트럭을 움직이기 전에 거울을 사용하여 주변을 확인합니다.

연석 쪽으로 후진을 시작하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_05_backward
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_05_backward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

trans-unit.source:
Continue to monitor your surroundings as you reverse into the parking spot.

Stop at the designated spot.
trans-unit.target:
주차 공간으로 후진할 때 주변 환경을 계속 주의 깊게 살펴봅니다.

지정된 구역에서 정지하세요.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_05_stop
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_05_stop Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_05

aca_scenario_book1_2_06_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_06_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: The last scenario in this chapter is a drive on an advanced training course. We'll put the skills you've learned with a tractor unit to the test!
trans-unit.target: 이 장의 마지막 시나리오는 고급 교육 과정을 운전하는 것입니다. 트랙터 유닛으로 배운 기술을 시험해 보겠습니다!

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_2_06_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_06_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.note: The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "O último cenário deste capítulo é uma condução através de um percurso de treinamento avançado. Vamos colocar à prova as habilidades que você aprendeu com o cavalo mecânico!"

aca_goal_book1_2_06_forward
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_06_forward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_goal_book1_2_06_check11

aca_goal_book1_2_06_check12
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_06_check12 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_goal_book1_2_06_check13
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_06_check13 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_goal_book1_2_06_check14
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_06_check14 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_goal_book1_2_06_check15
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_06_check15 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_goal_book1_2_06_check17
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_06_check17 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: For the final scenario of this chapter, we'll drive on the test track with a complex configuration.
trans-unit.target: 이 장의 마지막 시나리오에서는 복잡한 구성의 테스트 트랙에서 운전해 보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene01
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene01 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: The first obstacle is a slalom through some barriers. Drive through it and remember to use your mirrors.
trans-unit.target: 첫 번째 장애물은 몇몇 장벽을 통과하는 슬라롬입니다. 통과할 때는 거울을 사용하는 것을 잊지 마십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene02
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene02 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: Next is a hairpin turn. Keep your turn wide and it shouldn't pose you any problems.
trans-unit.target: 다음은 헤어핀 턴입니다. 회전을 넓게 유지하면 문제가 되지 않을 것입니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene04
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene04 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: There is a 90 degree left turn here. Remember to drive in deep so that the rear of the truck clears the inside barriers.
trans-unit.target: 여기에는 90도 좌회전이 있습니다. 트럭의 뒤쪽이 안쪽 장벽을 넘을 수 있도록 깊이 운전하는 것을 기억하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene05
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene05 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: The ramp obstacle can be a bit tricky. Line yourself up as best as you can before you drive onto it and use your front and side mirrors to help orient yourself.
trans-unit.target: 경사로 장애물은 약간 까다로울 수 있습니다. 운전하기 전에 최대한 정렬하고 전방과 사이드 미러를 사용하여 방향을 잡으십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene06
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene06 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: The next section must be done in reverse. Approach the barriers ahead with that in mind.
trans-unit.target: 다음 구간은 역순으로 수행해야 합니다. 이를 염두에 두고 전방의 장벽에 접근하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene08
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene08 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: Follow the road markings back and to the right of you.
trans-unit.target: 도로 표시를 따라 뒤 오른쪽으로 가십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene09
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene09 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: Reverse to the barriers, then stop and proceed forwards to the left.
trans-unit.target: 장벽으로 후진한 후, 멈추고 왼쪽으로 계속 전진하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene10
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene10 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: Proceed through the break in the median to the next section.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene11
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene11 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: This passage through the cones is very narrow. Drive slowly and use your mirrors to orient yourself within the passage.
trans-unit.target: 이 콘을 통과하는 통로는 매우 좁습니다. 천천히 운전하고 거울을 사용하여 통로 내에서 방향을 잡으세요.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene13
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene13 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: Remember to drive in deep on 90 degree turns.
trans-unit.target: 90도 회전 시에는 깊이 들어가는 것을 잊지 마십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene15
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene15 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: You are entering a nice open section of road. You can pick up some speed, but keep in mind you'll need to slow down soon for the curve up ahead.
trans-unit.target: 당신은 도로의 멋진 개방된 구간에 들어서고 있습니다. 속도를 낼 수 있지만, 앞으로의 커브를 위해 곧 속도를 줄여야 한다는 것을 명심하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene16
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene16 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: At the bottom of the hill there are some barriers across the road. Drive up to them, then reverse into the parking spot on the left.
trans-unit.target: 언덕 아래에는 도로 건너편에 몇 개의 장벽이 있습니다. 그곳까지 운전한 다음 왼쪽에 있는 주차 공간으로 후진하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene18
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene18 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene19
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene19 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: Park, then shut down the engine and secure the truck.
trans-unit.target: 주차한 후, 엔진을 끄고 트럭을 고정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene20
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_cutscene20 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
In front of you is a slalom made of barriers.

Drive through the slalom.
trans-unit.target:
당신 앞에는 장벽으로 이루어진 슬라롬이 있습니다.

슬라롬을 통과하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_forward
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_forward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
Keep towards the outside of the turn to ensure the rear of the tractor doesn't go over the kerb.

Make the turn.
trans-unit.target:
트랙터의 뒤쪽이 연석을 넘어가지 않도록 회전 바깥쪽을 유지합니다.

회전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.note:
The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "Abra bastante antes de fazer a curva para garantir que a parte traseira do cavalo mecânico não ultrapasse o meio-fio.

Faça a curva."

trans-unit.source:
You are coming up to a 90 degree left turn. Remember to use all the space you have available.

Make the turn.
trans-unit.target:
90도 좌회전을 하게 됩니다. 사용 가능한 모든 공간을 활용합니다.

회전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check2
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
Align yourself with the ramp. There isn't much room to make corrections once you are on it.

Drive over the ramp.
trans-unit.target:
램프에 맞춰 정렬하세요. 램프에 올라선 후에는 수정할 여지가 많지 않습니다.

램프 위로 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check3
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Follow the course to the left. </font>

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check4
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
The following section must be completed in reverse. Stop at the barriers ahead so that you can reverse to the right afterwards.

Stop at the barriers.
trans-unit.target:
다음 구간은 역순으로 완료해야 합니다. 앞의 장벽에서 멈추고 나서 오른쪽으로 후진할 수 있습니다.

장벽에서 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check5
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.note: Is it intentional to be missing a space between <barriers.> and </font>?

The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "O desafio a seguir deve ser realizado em marcha ré. Pare nas barreiras à frente para poder dar ré em direção à direita.

Pare nas barreiras."

trans-unit.source:
Reverse towards the area behind you and to the right. There are arrows on the road to help assist you.

Reverse towards the next section.
trans-unit.target:
뒤 오른쪽 구역으로 후진합니다. 도로에는 당신을 도울 화살표가 있습니다.

다음 구역으로 후진하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_reverse
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_reverse Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Keep reversing towards the barriers behind you.</font>
trans-unit.target: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>뒤에 있는 장벽을 향해 계속 후진하십시오.</font>

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check6
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check6 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
Stop and change into a forward gear, then continue to the left.

Drive forwards.
trans-unit.target:
멈추고 전진 기어로 바꾼 후 왼쪽으로 계속 운전합니다.

앞으로 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check7
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check7 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
There is a break in the median to the left. Drive through it.

Continue onwards.
trans-unit.target:
왼쪽 중앙분리대가 끊어져 있습니다. 그곳을 통과하세요.

계속해서 가십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check8
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check8 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
In front of you is a narrow winding path through some cones. Drive carefully and use your mirrors if necessary.

Drive through the cones.
trans-unit.target:
앞에는 몇 개의 콘을 통과하는 좁고 구불구불한 길이 있습니다. 조심해서 운전하고 필요한 경우 거울을 사용합니다.

콘을 통과하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check9
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check9 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
Continue through the course.

Turn left.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check10
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check10 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
Remember to keep left before the turn to give yourself as much room as possible.

Make the turn.
trans-unit.target:
회전하기 전에 왼쪽을 유지하여 가능한 한 많은 공간을 확보하세요.

회전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check11
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check11 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_msg_book1_2_06_check12
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check12 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
You can pick some speed up here, but there is a curve coming up ahead.

Continue along the course.
trans-unit.target:
여기서 속도를 낼 수 있지만, 앞에 커브가 있습니다.

코스를 따라 계속 가십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check13
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check13 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
The curve gets sharper as you make your way through it.

Adjust your speed accordingly and carry on.
trans-unit.target:
커브는 지날수록 점점 더 날카로워집니다.

속도를 적절히 조절하고 계속 가십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check14
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check14 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
At the bottom of the hill you will see barriers blocking the road.

Stop near the barriers.
trans-unit.target:
언덕 아래에 도로를 막고 있는 장벽이 보일 것입니다.

장벽 근처에서 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check15
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check15 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

trans-unit.source:
Behind you and to the left, there is a parking spot.

Reverse into the parking spot.
trans-unit.target:
당신 뒤 왼쪽에 주차 공간이 있습니다.

주차 공간으로 후진 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_06_check16
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check16 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_msg_book1_2_06_check17
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_06_check17 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_06

aca_scenario_book1_2_08_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_08_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll take a drive on a track designed to test your ability to handle the truck through different kind of curves and corners.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 트럭을 타고 다양한 커브와 모서리를 통과하는 능력을 테스트하기 위해 설계된 트랙에서 운전해 보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_2_08_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_08_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

aca_goal_book1_2_08_forward
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_08_forward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

aca_goal_book1_2_08_check1
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_08_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

aca_goal_book1_2_08_check2
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_08_check2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

aca_goal_book1_2_08_check3
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_08_check3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

aca_goal_book1_2_08_check4
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_08_check4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

aca_goal_book1_2_08_check6
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_08_check6 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

aca_goal_book1_2_08_check7
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_08_check7 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll take the tractor unit for a short drive to see how you handle it with your newly acquired skills.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 트랙터를 잠깐 운전해서 새로 습득한 기술로 트랙터를 어떻게 다루는지 살펴보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.note: The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "Neste cenário, faremos uma curta viagem com o cavalo mecânico para ver como você o conduz com as suas novas habilidades aprendidas."
@DTavares2112 Simplified and updated.

trans-unit.source: There are various types and combinations of turns on the track. It's not a race and it's not about time. Be patient and adjust your driving speed to the turns and obstacles you encounter.
trans-unit.target: 트랙에는 다양한 유형과 조합의 회전이 있습니다. 경주가 아니고 시간에 대한 것도 아닙니다. 인내심을 갖고 마주치는 회전과 장애물에 맞춰 운전 속도를 조절하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source: At the beginning the course is gentle and easy, but the turns will get more complex as you go.
trans-unit.target: 처음에는 코스가 완만하고 쉽지만, 점점 더 복잡해지는 코너를 만나게 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.note: Possibly a duplicated "more", it should read "but the turns will get more complex as you go."

trans-unit.source: Be mindful of your speed; it's easy to get going too fast and then misjudge a turn.
trans-unit.target: 속도에 주의하세요; 너무 빨리 달리다 보면 방향 전환을 잘못 판단하기 쉽습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.note: ";" is there on purpose?

trans-unit.source: The exit from the track is a very tight hairpin turn. Go slow and use all the space available to you.
trans-unit.target: 트랙 출구는 급한 헤어핀 턴입니다. 천천히 진행하여 사용 가능한 모든 공간을 활용하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene6
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene6 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source: Park between the barriers and secure the truck.
trans-unit.target: 장벽 사이에 차량을 주차하고 트럭을 고정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene7
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_cutscene7 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source:
To complete this scenario successfully, you must not crash, drive off of the track, or hit any traffic cones.

Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
이 시나리오를 성공적으로 완료하려면 충돌하거나 트랙에서 벗어나거나 트래픽콘에 부딪혀서는 안 됩니다.

출발을 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Proceed forwards into the sharp right turn to enter the course. </font>
trans-unit.target: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>급격한 오른쪽 방향으로 직진하여 코스에 진입합니다. </font>

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_forward
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_forward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Drive through the turn at a nice steady speed. </font>

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_check1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source:
You're approaching a more complex section of winding turns.

Adjust your speed accordingly and continue.
trans-unit.target:
좀 더 구불구불한 회전구간에 접근하고 있습니다.

속도를 적절히 조절하고 계속 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_check2
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_check2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Continue towards the next set of turns.</font>
trans-unit.target: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>다음 회전 세트를 향해 계속 진행하십시오.</font>

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_check3
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_check3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source:
There are some easy, gentle turns coming. Keep your speed steady.

Continue driving.
trans-unit.target:
몇 개의 쉬운, 부드러운 회전이 다가옵니다. 속도를 일정하게 유지하세요.

계속 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_check4
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_check4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source:
The turn out of the course is a sharp hairpin turn. Slow down and stay to the outside before the turn. Be sure to use your mirrors!

Turn out of the course.
trans-unit.target:
코스에서 나가는 급한 헤어핀 턴입니다. 회전하기 전에 속도를 줄이고 바깥쪽으로 나가십시오. 거울을 꼭 사용하세요!

코스에서 벗어나십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_check6
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_check6 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

trans-unit.source:
Ahead of you there is a parking spot between some barriers.

Proceed towards the parking spot.
trans-unit.target:
앞쪽에 몇몇 장벽 사이에 주차 공간이 있습니다.

주차 공간을 향해 나아가십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_08_check7
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_08_check7 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_08

aca_scenario_book1_2_09_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_09_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll take a look at parallel parking between two other trucks.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 두 대의 다른 트럭 사이의 평행 주차를 살펴보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_2_09_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_2_09_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source: Stopping in Front of the Parking Spot

context-group.context:
aca_goal_book1_2_09_stopmid
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_09_stopmid Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

aca_goal_book1_2_09_checkmirror
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_09_checkmirror Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

aca_goal_book1_2_09_backward
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_09_backward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

aca_goal_book1_2_09_stop
Id: aca_goal_book1_2_09_stop Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source:
Parallel parking is a crucial skill every trucker should know.
Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
평행 주차는 모든 트럭 운전사가 알아야 할 중요한 기술입니다.
출발 준비를 하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source:
Drive towards the parking spot.
Pay attention to your surroundings.
trans-unit.target:
주차 공간을 향해 운전합니다.
주변 환경에 주의하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source: Align yourself with the truck in front of your parking spot. Don't be too close to it, keep some distance from it so you have room to work.
trans-unit.target: 주차 공간 앞에 있는 트럭과 일렬로 정렬하세요. 트럭과 너무 가까이 있지 말고, 작업할 공간을 확보하기 위해 트럭과 거리를 두십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source: Turn sharply towards the space and start reversing.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source: When looking out your driver's side mirror, aim for kerb just in front of the truck behind you.
trans-unit.target: 운전석 쪽 거울로 볼 때, 뒤에 있는 트럭 바로 앞의 연석을 향하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene5
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.note: Shouldn't the expression <side mirror> be only mentioned for the mirror that is mounted above the passenger side window? In the game the mirrors are listed as: the main mirrors on the driver and passenger side, the front mirror on the upper right corner of the windscreen and the above mentioned, side mirror. Why make it so confusing by saying <side mirror> when it should be <main mirror>? It is so frustrating, because this is not the first confusing mention of <side mirror> from this batch of translations.
The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "Használd a vezetőoldali tükröt, és célozd be vele a mögötted álló kamion előtti padkát!"

trans-unit.source: Once your front bumper clears the truck ahead of you, you can begin steering the front end of the truck into the spot, aligning the truck with the parking spot.
trans-unit.target: 앞 범퍼가 앞의 트럭을 넘으면, 트럭의 앞부분을 조종하여 주차 위치에 정렬할 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene6
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene6 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source:
Straighten out the wheel and centre out the truck within the parking spot.
Park and secure the truck.
trans-unit.target:
앞바퀴를 정렬 하고 트럭을 주차 공간의 중앙에 놓습니다.
주차하고 트럭을 고정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene7
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_cutscene7 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.note: In this case, the use of <wheel> has the meaning of <steering wheel>?

trans-unit.source:
Ahead of you there are some parked trucks. There's one open space left for you to park in.

Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
앞에는 주차된 트럭이 몇 대 있습니다. 당신이 주차할 수 있는 빈 공간이 하나 남았습니다.

출발을 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source:
Remember to be aware of your surroundings. Make good use of your mirrors throughout this manoeuvre.

Drive forwards.
trans-unit.target:
주변 상황을 주의 깊게 살펴보세요. 이 조작 내내 거울을 잘 활용하세요.

앞으로 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_check1
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source:
Drive past the parking spot and into the marked area. From there you can begin your reversing manoeuvre.

Stop in the marked spot.
trans-unit.target:
주차 공간을 지나 표시된 구역으로 들어가세요. 거기에서 후진 조작을 시작할 수 있습니다.

표시된 지점에서 멈추 십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_stopmid
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_stopmid Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source:
Check your surroundings for obstacles and to make sure you are clear to reverse.

Look through the passenger's side mirror.
trans-unit.target:
주변에 장애물이 있는지 확인하고 후진할 수 있는 공간이 있는지 확인합니다.

조수석 쪽 거울을 통해 살펴보십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_checkmirror
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_checkmirror Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source:
Turn your wheels and reverse into the parking spot.

Start reversing.
trans-unit.target:
바퀴를 돌려 후진 주차 공간으로 들어가세요.

후진을 시작하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_backward
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_backward Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

trans-unit.source:
Start straightening the truck out when appropriate. Don't drive over the kerb!

Align the truck with the spot.
trans-unit.target:
적절할 때 트럭을 정렬 하기 시작하십시오. 연석을 넘어 운전하지 마세요!

트럭을 해당 지점에 맞춰 정렬하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_2_09_stop
Id: aca_msg_book1_2_09_stop Group: Book 1 Scenario 2_09

aca_scenario_book1_3_01_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_3_01_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll explain the basics of connecting and disconnecting the tractor unit to a trailer.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 트랙터 장치를 트레일러에 연결하고 분리하는 기본 사항을 설명하겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_3_01_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_3_01_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.note: The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "Neste cenário, explicaremos os princípios básicos de engatar e desengatar o cavalo mecânico de um reboque."

context-group.context:
aca_goal_book1_3_01_check_con
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_01_check_con Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_goal_book1_3_01_connect
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_01_connect Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_goal_book1_3_01_park_br_off
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_01_park_br_off Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_goal_book1_3_01_disc5
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_01_disc5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_goal_book1_3_01_park_br_off2
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_01_park_br_off2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_goal_book1_3_01_disconnect
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_01_disconnect Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_goal_book1_3_01_stop
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_01_stop Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll try connecting and disconnecting a trailer for the first time. Get the truck ready to go, then reverse under the trailer behind you.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 처음으로 트레일러를 연결하고 분리해 보겠습니다. 트럭을 출발할 준비를 한 다음, 뒤에 있는 트레일러 아래로 후진하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source: Connect the trailer, then pull forwards.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source: Park in the parking spot and secure the truck.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene5
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_cutscene5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source:
In this scenario, we'll discuss the procedures for connecting and disconnecting the tractor and trailer. This is a simplified procedure compared to what a trucker will encounter in real life.

Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
이 시나리오에서는 트랙터와 트레일러를 연결하고 분리하는 절차에 대해 설명합니다. 이는 트럭 운전사가 실제로 마주하게 될 절차에 비하면 간소화된 절차입니다.

출발을 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source:
There's a trailer located behind the tractor unit. Slowly reverse under the trailer until the fifth wheel hits the kingpin. Currently, the truck is correctly aligned so there is no need to steer, just reverse straight.

Reverse slowly until you feel a connection.
trans-unit.target:
트랙터 유닛 뒤에 트레일러가 있습니다. 커플러가 킹핀에 닿을 때까지 트레일러 아래에서 천천히 후진합니다. 현재 트럭은 올바르게 정렬되어 있으므로 조향 할 필요가 없고, 그냥 똑바로 후진합니다.

연결이 느껴질 때까지 천천히 후진하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_check_con
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_check_con Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source:
The fifth wheel has coupled to the kingpin.

Secure the truck by applying the parking brake.
trans-unit.target:
커플러가 킹핀에 연결되었습니다.

주차 브레이크를 작동하여 트럭을 고정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_park_br_on
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_park_br_on Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source:
In real life, the fifth wheel automatically locks the kingpin, then the trucker would need to exit the vehicle to retract the landing gear and connect the air and electrical lines.

For us, simply pressing @@imv_nrm_attach@@ will connect the trailer.
trans-unit.target:
실제로 커플러 자동으로 킹핀을 잠그고, 트럭 운전사는 차량에서 나와 랜딩 기어를 접고 에어 및 전선을 연결해야 합니다.

우리의 경우, @@imv_nrm_attach@@를 누르기만 하면 트레일러가 연결됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_connect
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_connect Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source:
Now that the tractor is safely connected to the trailer, you're ready to move forwards. Keep in mind that your vehicle is now considerably longer and heavier and will require a new set of skills to operate.

Release your parking brake and prepare to drive forwards.
trans-unit.target:
이제 트랙터가 트레일러에 안전하게 연결되었으므로 앞으로 나아갈 준비가 되었습니다. 차량이 상당히 길고 무거워졌으며 작동하려면 새로운 기술이 필요하다는 점을 명심하세요.

주차 브레이크를 풀고 앞으로 나아갈 준비를 하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_park_br_off
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_park_br_off Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source:
Drive forwards.

Stop in the marked area ahead.
trans-unit.target:
앞으로 운전하세요.

앞에 표시된 구역에서 멈추 십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_check_discon
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_check_discon Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_msg_book1_3_01_parking_brake5
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_parking_brake5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_msg_book1_3_01_stop5
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_stop5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01
Temp

trans-unit.note: This step is repeated with the previous one. Possible continuity error?
@Nettle - could you help with more context/screenshot for this one? We want to understand if this is still relevant.

trans-unit.source:
Once again, in real life, the trucker would have to exit the vehicle, lower the landing gear, disconnect the air and electrical lines, and release the fifth wheel locking mechanism.

We simplify this process for you, so pressing @@imv_nrm_attach@@ will disconnect the trailer.
trans-unit.target:
다시 한번, 현실에서 트럭 운전사는 차량에서 나와 랜딩 기어를 내리고 에어 및 전선을 분리한 다음 커플러 잠금장치를 해제해야 합니다.

저희는 이 과정을 간소화해 드리니 @@imv_nrm_attach@@를 누르면 트레일러가 분리됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_disc5
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_disc5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_msg_book1_3_01_park_br_off2
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_park_br_off2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

trans-unit.source:
Pull the tractor out from under the trailer and move forwards.

Stop in the marked area.
trans-unit.target:
트레일러 아래에서 트랙터를 꺼내 앞으로 이동하십시오.

표시된 구역에서 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_01_park_br_off3
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_park_br_off3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_msg_book1_3_01_stop
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_01_stop Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_01

aca_scenario_book1_3_02_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_3_02_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you'll get a feel for driving and braking with a trailer attached.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 트레일러를 연결한 상태에서 운전하고 제동 하는 방법을 익힐 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_3_02_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_3_02_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

aca_goal_book1_3_02_forward
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_02_forward Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

aca_goal_book1_3_02_check1
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_02_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source: Reaching a Speed of 60 km/h (37 mph)

context-group.context:
aca_goal_book1_3_02_check2
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_02_check2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

aca_goal_book1_3_02_check3
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_02_check3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll take the truck for a short drive. You'll be able to get a feel for braking with a trailer as we descend the hill ahead. Prepare the truck and set off.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 트럭을 타고 짧은 거리를 운전합니다. 앞의 언덕을 내려가면서 트레일러로 제동 하는 느낌을 얻을 수 있을 것입니다. 트럭을 준비하고 출발합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_cutscene01
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_cutscene01 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source: Reach a speed of at least 60 km/h (37 mph). Be ready for the braking zone ahead.
trans-unit.target: 최소 60km/h (37mph)의 속도에 도달하세요. 앞의 제동 구역에 대비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_cutscene06
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_cutscene06 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source: Begin braking to a stop. Make sure you don't wait too long, or you could hit the barriers in front of you!
trans-unit.target: 브레이크를 밟아 정지하기 시작하세요. 너무 오래 기다리지 않도록 주의하십시오. 그렇지 않으면 앞에 있는 장벽에 부딪힐 수 있습니다!

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_cutscene08
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_cutscene08 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source: Park in the designated area, then secure the truck and shut down the engine.
trans-unit.target: 지정된 구역에 주차한 후, 트럭을 고정하고 엔진을 끄십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_cutscene10
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_cutscene10 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source:
During this drive, you'll get a feel for using the service brakes while descending a downhill grade. The purpose of this drill is to become aware of the weight behind you and how it affects the braking distance of the vehicle.

Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
이 운전에서는 내리막길을 내려가는 동안 풋 브레이크를 사용하는 방법을 익힐 수 있습니다. 이 훈련의 목적은 뒤에 있는 무게를 인식하고 차량의 제동 거리에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 알아내는 것입니다.

출발을 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source:
Start driving now, and keep in mind you will need to reach a speed of 60 km/h (37 mph).

Drive through the turn.
trans-unit.target:
지금 운전을 시작하고, 최소 60km (37mph)의 속도에 도달해야 한다는 점을 명심하세요.

회전을 마치십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_forward
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_forward Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Continue to accelerate down the hill. </font>

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_check1
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source: <font face=/font/big_bold.font>Reach a speed of at least 60 km/h (37 mph). </font>

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_check2
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_check2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

trans-unit.source:
You've reached the required speed.

Stop at the barriers ahead.
trans-unit.target:
필요한 속도에 도달했습니다.

앞의 장벽에 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_02_check3
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_02_check3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_02

aca_scenario_book1_3_03_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_3_03_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll explore manoeuvring the trailer through a short obstacle course with more complex turns.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 더 복잡한 회전이 있는 짧은 장애물 코스를 통해 트레일러를 조종하는 방법을 알아보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_3_03_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_3_03_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

aca_goal_book1_3_03_check1
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_03_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

aca_goal_book1_3_03_check4
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_03_check4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

aca_goal_book1_3_03_check5
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_03_check5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

aca_goal_book1_3_03_chk_point
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_03_chk_point Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
Ahead are a variety of complex corners and obstacles.
Take everything you've learned so far into account and it shouldn't be too difficult.
trans-unit.target:
앞에는 다양하고 복잡한 코너와 장애물이 있습니다.
지금까지 배운 내용을 모두 고려한다면 그렇게 어렵지 않을 겁니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene01
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene01 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source: The road markings can help give you an idea of how to proceed through each set of obstacles.
trans-unit.target: 도로 표시는 각각의 장애물을 어떻게 통과해야 할지에 대한 아이디어를 얻는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene02
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene02 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
Keep the tractor to the outside of the corner.
You'll need to swing wide as the trailer follows a shorter path.
trans-unit.target:
트랙터를 모서리 바깥쪽에 두세요.
트레일러는 짧은 경로를 따라가므로 넓게 선회해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene03
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene03 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
The next corner is an easy 90 degree turn.
Once again, keep the truck to the outside of the turn and utilize all the space available to you.
trans-unit.target:
다음 코너는 90도로 쉽게 돌 수 있는 코너입니다.
다시 한번, 트럭을 코너 바깥쪽에 두고 사용 가능한 모든 공간을 활용하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene04
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene04 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source: Take your time here. The course opens up, but you will still need to be precise.
trans-unit.target: 여기서 시간을 내세요. 코스가 열리지만 여전히 정확해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene05
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene05 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source: Keep a wide berth around the barriers.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene06
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene06 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
Take care as you enter this narrow section.
Swing the tractor wide well before you enter to set your trailer up for entry.
trans-unit.target:
좁은 구역에 들어갈 때는 조심하세요.
들어가기 전에 트랙터를 넓게 휘둘러 트레일러가 들어갈 수 있도록 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene07
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene07 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source: The final 90 degree turn is much sharper than the first, but there is plenty of room if you use your space wisely.
trans-unit.target: 최종 90도 회전은 첫 번째 회전보다 훨씬 급하지만, 공간을 현명하게 사용하면 충분한 여유 공간이 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene09
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene09 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source: Stop in the designated area, then secure the truck and switch off the engine.
trans-unit.target: 지정된 구역에 정차한 후, 트럭을 고정하고 엔진을 끄십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene10
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_cutscene10 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
Remember to utilize the road markings to help you navigate the course.

Prepare to set off.
trans-unit.target:
코스를 탐색하는 데 도움이 되는 도로 표시를 활용하세요.

출발을 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_start
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_start Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
Using your mirrors will also help you to navigate the course safely. You must always be aware of how the trailer is tracking behind you.

Proceed through the first corner.
trans-unit.target:
거울을 사용하면 코스를 안전하게 탐색하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 트레일러가 뒤에서 어떻게 움직이는지 항상 알고 있어야 합니다.

첫 번째 코너를 통과합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_forward
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_forward Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
Observe the trailer as you exit the turn and prepare to enter the next one.

Proceed through the next turn.
trans-unit.target:
회전에서 나갈 때 트레일러를 관찰하고 다음 회전으로 들어갈 준비를 하세요.

다음 회전을 진행하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_check1
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
Remember to observe your trailer to ensure you are clear of the obstacles around you before turning the truck.

Continue around the barrier obstacle ahead.
trans-unit.target:
트럭을 돌리기 전에 주변 장애물이 없는지 확인하기 위해 트레일러를 관찰하세요.

앞의 장벽 장애물을 돌아가시십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_check2
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_check2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
When your trailer is clear of the barrier, turn hard to the passenger's side to line yourself up for the narrow passage.

Proceed towards the narrow passage.
trans-unit.target:
트레일러가 장벽을 통과하면 좁은 통로로 들어가기 위해 조수석 쪽으로 방향을 크게 틀어줍니다.

좁은 통로를 향해 나아가십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_check3
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_check3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
This section will require very precise driving. Take your time and use your mirrors.

Stay towards the outside of each corner.
trans-unit.target:
이 구간은 매우 정밀한 운전이 필요합니다. 천천히 거울을 사용합니다.

각 코너 바깥쪽을 유지하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_check4
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_check4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

trans-unit.source:
This turn is very sharp, but you can utilize all the space in front of you to clear it easily.

Make the final turn.
trans-unit.target:
이 회전은 매우 급하지만, 앞의 모든 공간을 활용하여 쉽게 넘을 수 있습니다.

마지막 턴을 하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_03_check5
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_03_check5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_03

aca_scenario_book1_3_04_title
Id: aca_scenario_book1_3_04_title Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note: course as in lesson or driving?

trans-unit.source: In the final scenario of Chapter 3, we'll take a drive on a longer training course with a variety of different turns to see how well you've learned to manoeuvre with a trailer.
trans-unit.target: 챕터 3의 마지막 시나리오에서는 다양한 회전이 있는 더 긴 훈련 코스를 운전하여 트레일러로 조작하는 법을 얼마나 잘 배웠는지 확인해 보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book1_3_04_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book1_3_04_desc Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_goal_book1_3_04_check1
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check1 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note: "Dogleg" needs to be explained a little more! What exactly does that mean?

context-group.context:
aca_goal_book1_3_04_check2
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check2 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note: I suppose we shouldn't translate this string, as it's candidate for deletion, right? ;)

context-group.context:
aca_goal_book1_3_04_check3
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check3 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note: "Median Crossover" needs to be explained a little more! What exactly does that mean?

context-group.context:
aca_goal_book1_3_04_check4
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check4 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_goal_book1_3_04_check5
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check5 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_goal_book1_3_04_check6
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check6 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_goal_book1_3_04_check7
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check7 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_goal_book1_3_04_check8
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check8 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_goal_book1_3_04_check9
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check9 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_goal_book1_3_04_check10
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check10 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_goal_book1_3_04_check11
Id: aca_goal_book1_3_04_check11 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note: Is it a miss to not have <the> as a definite article before <Parking Spot>?

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you'll face a variety of different turns to help you get used to driving with a trailer. Stay focused, adjust your speed to each situation, and make full use of the space available on the training course.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 트레일러 운전에 익숙해지도록 다양한 턴을 마주하게 됩니다. 집중하고, 각 상황에 맞게 속도를 조절하고, 훈련 코스에서 사용 가능한 공간을 최대한 활용하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene01
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene01 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note:
Para manter o padrão de tradução, recomendo a mudança da palavra "trailer" por "reboque". Segue a sugestão:
"Neste cenário, você enfrentará uma variedade de curvas diferentes para ajudá-lo a se acostumar a dirigir com um reboque. Mantenha o foco, ajuste sua velocidade a cada situação e faça uso total do espaço disponível no curso de treinamento."
@DTavares2112 Simplified and update.

trans-unit.source: The first turn is a dogleg turn - two turns in one. You'll have to set up for a left turn, but transition to a right turn in the middle of the manoeuvre.
trans-unit.target: 첫 번째 턴은 도그렉 턴입니다. 한 번에 두 개의 회전이 있습니다. 좌회전을 준비해야 하지만 조작 중간에 우회전으로 전환해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene02
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene02 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.source: This next turn crosses you over to the other side of the median. It's not particularly difficult but you will need to watch that you leave enough space for your trailer.
trans-unit.target: 다음 턴은 중앙분리대의 반대편으로 넘어갑니다. 특별히 어렵지는 않지만 트레일러에 충분한 공간을 남겨두는지 확인해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene03
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene03 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.source: Next you'll have to negotiate a tight slalom through the concrete barriers. Go slow and use your mirrors, and make sure you swing wide enough so your trailer can clear the barriers.
trans-unit.target: 다음으로 콘크리트 장벽을 통과하는 좁은 슬라롬을 통과해야 합니다. 천천히 가면서 거울을 사용하고 트레일러가 장벽을 넘을 수 있을 만큼 충분히 넓게 회전해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene04
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene04 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note: The currently approved translation is not correct. Please review my suggestion: "Em seguida, você terá que conduzir através de um zigue-zague apertado entre as barreiras de concreto. Vá devagar, use os retrovisores e certifique-se de fazer curvas abertas o suficiente para que seu reboque passe pelas barreiras."
@DTavares2112 Simplified and updated.

trans-unit.source:
At this point, you'll enter another slalom complimented by extra cones at the apex of each curve.
Be sure not to hit any of them!
trans-unit.target:
이 포인트에서, 각 커브의 정점에 추가 콘이 설치된 또 다른 회전 코스에 진입하게 됩니다.
콘 중 아무것에도 부딪히지 않도록 주의하십시오!

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene05
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene05 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note: Missing a <.> dot punctuation sign after <curve>?

trans-unit.source: Next are a couple of easy corners on your way to the roundabout.
trans-unit.target: 회전교차로로 가는 길에 몇 개의 쉬운 코너가 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene06
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene06 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.source: Use the straight section to prepare for entering the roundabout. Stay to the outside before you enter it.
trans-unit.target: 회전교차로 진입을 준비하려면 직선 구간을 이용합니다. 진입하기 전에 바깥쪽에 머물러야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene07
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene07 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.source: Enter the roundabout and watch the placement of your trailer. It will track differently once you are inside the roundabout compared to how you entered.
trans-unit.target: 회전교차로에 들어가 트레일러의 위치를 살펴봅니다. 회전교차로에 들어가면 진입할 때와 다르게 추적됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene08
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene08 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.source: Exit the roundabout and drive on to the next set of turns.
trans-unit.target: 회전교차로를 빠져나와 다음 회전 방향으로 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene09
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene09 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene10
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene10 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.note: i think something else should be here

trans-unit.source: The turn here is extremely sharp. Take it slow and use the space around you smartly. Be mindful of the trailer's tail swing as well.
trans-unit.target: 이곳의 회전은 매우 급격합니다. 천천히 여유를 갖고 주변 공간을 현명하게 활용해보세요. 트레일러의 꼬리 회전에도 주의하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene11
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene11 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.source: As you drive through the next few turns, remember to try and set yourself up for the next turn as you exit the previous one.
trans-unit.target: 다음 몇 개의 코너를 지날 때, 이전 코너에서 나올 때와 마찬가지로 다음 코너에 대비해 미리 준비를 해두는 것을 잊지 마십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene12
Id: aca_msg_book1_3_04_cutscene12 Group: Book 1 Scenario 3_04

trans-unit.source: Don't rush the final corner. It looks easy, but there is less room to manoeuvre than there appears to be.
trans-unit.target: 마지막 코너를 서두르지 마십시오. 쉬워 보이지만, 보이는 것보다 조작할 공간이 적습니다.
